text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Orfe.
I understand without you having to say a word."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Her strength has visibly improved.
This proves once again that Orfe's eye
was true.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Had they been useless,
Sister would have cast them aside as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: (...Something is welling up from deep within.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
(It feels like a new power
that I have never felt before...)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My authority remains unchanged, yet—
to think there was still something slumbering within me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...And you're saying his very existence
awakened something new?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
A hard worker deserves a reward, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Your performance this time was not bad.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Continue to apply yourself going forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving only those words behind, Orfevre walked away.
...It seemed I had just been praised.
